messages:
Maya Lopez: Quick sync: we need a concrete ops + schema plan for ownership pointer rewrites and how billing reconciles historical charges.
Darren Lee: Proposal: ledger is immutable. Keep indirection via pointer table for current ownership but embed compact owner_snapshot in every charge event for audits.
Rina Patel: Agreed. owner_snapshot should be minimal: owner_id, owner_type, seq, checksum. Compress to a 1-line string to save space.
Darren Lee: Emit path rules: 1) write charge event to append-only ledger synchronously; 2) best-effort enrich with pointer lookup; 3) if enrich fails write enrich_status=PENDING_ENRICH and proceed.
Maya Lopez: Reconciler flow: scan ledger for PENDING_ENRICH or checksum mismatch, compute canonical owner from pointer history, emit CORRECTION events referencing original charge_id, and update materialized billing table idempotently.
ReconcileBot: note: schedule nightly dry-run first, then canary near-real-time reconciles for flagged tenants.
Rina Patel: Pointer table shape: key=fingerprint, value=current_owner|seq|tombstone|last_updated. Maintain tiny per-key change log (ring buffer <=20) for history lookups. Archive old entries.
Darren Lee: Lease rules to avoid flip-flops: reassignment must increment seq and include min_hold_seconds (default 3600s) unless admin override. Collisions resolved by seq and timestamp.
Maya Lopez: Audit requirements checklist: embedded owner_snapshot OR pointer-history archive, reconcilers emit correction events, checksum quick-checks. Also reconciler actions must be auditable (signed/logged).
Rina Patel: Migration plan: Phase A emit snapshots only; Phase B deploy pointer service + dry-run reconciler; Phase C canary corrections; Phase D wide rollout.
Darren Lee: Ops alerts: page SRE if reconciler lag >6h for canary tenants or pointer 5xx >1% for 10m.
Maya Lopez: Next steps: Darren -> pointer-schema PR, Rina -> reconcile runbook and SLOs, I'll schedule 30m review when PRs land.
ReconcileBot: reconcilebot: nightly dry-run scheduled 2026-03-21T04:00Z.
Maya Lopez: Thanks team, will add PR links here when ready. :white_check_mark:
